title: Derived pullback computed on a specified localized strictly perfect model
statement: Let $g:T\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $U\subseteq X$ be an open, and put $V=g^{-1}(U)$. Let $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], let $K$ be a strictly perfect complex of modules on the localized site of $U$ [def-pc-perfect-complex, def-pur-localized-ringed-site], and fix an isomorphism $E|_U\cong Q(K)$. Define the ordinary localized pullback functor $F$ by the open-site equivalence from localized modules on $U$ to modules on $U$ as an open subscheme, followed by ordinary module pullback along $V\to U$ [def-pc-module-pullback], followed by the inverse open-site equivalence on $V$. There is an isomorphism $(Lg^*E)|_V\cong Q(F(K))$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], where $F(K)$ is the termwise image of $K$. The ambient and localized derived categories may have any common localization universe $w$; no affineness or quasi-coherence hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09UA, alternative proof via 09U7; restriction in 08DW and flat computation in 06YD/06YJ

proof.text: Put V = g inverse-image U. Construct F as Modules.overEquiv U followed by the ordinary module pullback of g.resLE U V and Modules.overEquiv V inverse. Transport K to a complex P on U.toScheme. Additivity preserves the zero terms beyond the upper bound of K. The open-site equivalence preserves coproducts and carries the unit to the unit, so its image of every finite free module is finite free. Map the retract maps of each K term to show that each P term is a retract of a finite free module.

Install the proved tensorClosed structures and the proved source SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian instance. The unit is flat by the monoidal unitors; flat_coproduct makes each finite free module flat. Apply the proved source ObjectProperty.flat_of_retract to the explicit mapped retract, and take its tensorRight exactness clause. Thus every term of P is flat.

Apply flatComplexDerivedPullback to g.resLE U V and P. Its functor F_tensor is identified with Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback by the recorded object and morphism equalities. The tensor pullback adjunction and the Mathlib module pullback adjunction have the same pushforward; leftAdjointUniq identifies the functors. Compose the canonical quotientCompQhIso, the inverse of the flat comparison, mapHomotopyCategoryFactors, quotientCompQhIso again, and the image under Q of the termwise adjoint-uniqueness isomorphism. This gives L(g.resLE)* Q(P) isomorphic to Q of the ordinary pulled P.

Choose standard derived categories on U.toScheme and V.toScheme independently of the ambient localization universe w. Use derivedPullback_openRestriction_iso_universes. The composition isomorphisms for exact mapDerivedCategory and the given model isomorphism e identify the image under the derived open-site equivalence of (Lg* E)|V with L(g.resLE)* Q(P). Compose with the isomorphism of the preceding step.

For C = Modules.overEquiv V functor, compose associators and the equivalence counit to obtain F followed by C isomorphic to Modules.overEquiv U functor followed by ordinary pullback. Apply mapHomologicalComplexCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryFactors to obtain the same Q of the ordinary pulled P from C.mapDerivedCategory applied to Q(F K). The two isomorphisms have a common target. Compose one with the inverse of the other and take preimageIso under the fully faithful C.mapDerivedCategory, proving the claimed local model isomorphism.

theorem localizedPullback_perfectModel_iso {T X : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ X)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : T.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings T.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    (U : X.Opens) (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hK : Scheme.IsStrictlyPerfect X U K)
    (e : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) :
    Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace) (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((derivedPullback g).obj E) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((Scheme.Modules.localizedPullback g U).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K))
